title: Nayagan
desc: A woman is kidnapped and held captive by a gang. Somehow, she makes a random call using a broken phone. Now, her only salvation is the person on the other end who is least interested in helping her.

title: Annai
desc: Maha, a rich widow, lets Anjali, a young orphan, live in her house for a month every year. Problems arise when Anjali criticises Maha's behaviour.

title: Gopala Gopala
desc: Gopal causes much angst among his male neighbours as he is friendly with their spouses. They are relieved when he marries Usha. But Usha leaves him after learning that he was married once before.

title: Andha 7 Naatkal
desc: When Vasanthi's husband, Dr Anand, learns that she was forcefully married to him, he decides to reunite her with her lover. However, Vasanthi soon falls for him and accepts him as her husband.

title: Hero
desc: Vinod, who aspires to be an actor, starts working on movie sets. Later, he marries an actress but has an ulterior motive behind making this decision.
